brief:
We Are Not Numbers reported that residents of Gaza face constant decisions between bleak alternatives in conditions described as ghostlike. The outlet's account emphasizes the constrained circumstances shaping daily life across the territory, where survival itself demands repeated selection among harmful options.

The report conveys a sense of pervasive difficulty penetrating ordinary existence, depicting an environment where inhabitants operate under severe duress and material scarcity.
dek: In ghostlike Gaza, we are constantly having to choose between dark alternatives.
title: Gaza residents navigate impossible choices amid humanitarian crisis
